canonical_project: TeleYemen Aden international gateway and cable landing station (Aden-Djibouti, AAE-1)
notes: Control side: IRG/STC-held Aden. TeleYemen official statement: AAE-1 landing station in Aden with TeleYemen capacity, investment up to ~US$40M (A-grade for gateway/cable-landing facts); Aden also lands Aden-Djibouti cable (1994, owners include TeleYemen per GeoCables; IRG government activated it for south Yemen late 2022 per ts2.tech). Gateway/hosting service = A; cable status volatile: Red Sea cable incidents 2024-2025 and a dual-authority dispute over TeleYemen representation on AAE-1 (IRG refusing Houthi-linked arm) keep AAE-1 status uncertain. Not a commercial colocation DC.
